eval_benchmarks: Global-MMLU, INCLUDE, XNLI, MGSM, FLORES-200, Belebele, FLEURS
cldr_coverage: 3 modern, 2 moderate, 1 basic, 0 not in CLDR
reach_text_share: Speakers who use the internet and can read and write text on a phone. Weighted by speakers in 5 countries: RU, UA, KZ, KG, BY
reach_text_share_5y: Projected internet use, 5 years ahead, times today's ability to text. Weighted by speakers in 5 countries: RU, UA, KZ, KG, BY
reach_voice_share: Speakers who use the internet. Weighted by speakers in 5 countries: RU, UA, KZ, KG, BY
reach_voice_share_5y: Internet use projected 5 years ahead on its recent trend. Weighted by speakers in 5 countries: RU, UA, KZ, KG, BY
speaker_growth_5y: Population growth over 5 years. Weighted by speakers in 5 countries: RU, UA, KZ, KG, BY
speech_fleurs: About 12 hours per language; CC BY 4.0
speech_yodas: Video hours with manually uploaded subtitles; CC BY 3.0
asr_whisper_fleurs_wer: Word error rate (character error rate for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai)
wikipedia_active_editors: Registered users with an edit in the last 30 days
asr_azure_features: Counts real-time, batch, fast transcription, mono- and multilingual refinement, LLM speech, MAI-Transcribe, custom speech with labeled audio, custom pronunciation, display format
asr_google: Any model or region counts; om and ig are on chirp_2 in one region only
mt_azure_features: Counts Custom Translator, auto language detection, dictionary, LLM translation, adaptive custom translation, scanned-document translation; source-only counts half
tts_azure: Read from a third-party copy of Azure's voice list; Microsoft's page loads the table separately

opportunities.title: 1 of 3 major voice assistants understand this language
opportunities.detail: One assistant already works in this language, so speech recognition, a voice and language understanding have been shown to be feasible.
opportunities.why: About 158 million Russian speakers are online today, and that should reach 167 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (8,007 hours of transcribed speech); FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: No published LLM benchmark results
opportunities.detail: Neither of the two multilingual benchmarks we track reports this language. Adding it would give builders and buyers a baseline.
opportunities.why: About 158 million Russian speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 166 million within five years. Ready to use: FLORES-200 (covers this language); Belebele (covers this language).
